sections.heading: Robert De Niro — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Robert De Niro was born on 17 August 1943 in New York City and Manhattan, and holds American and Italian nationality. He was given the name Robert Anthony De Niro at birth and is publicly known as Robert De Niro.
Public records name his father, Robert De Niro Sr. and his mother, Virginia Admiral.
His listed education includes Stella Adler Studio of Acting, Lee Strasberg Theatre and Film Institute, Little Red School House and Elisabeth Irwin High School and HB Studio.
He is recorded as speaking English.

He has held the following offices: President of the Jury at the Cannes Festival.
